test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: HARKED is related to RAHDEK in a certain way. In the same way, RACIAL is related to CARLAI. To which of the following is NIMBLE related, following the same logic?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ca63fa0a9b1d8d94e9032be998e74b7faff301d8847e785439c04e89b02dfd4.png] 

For, HARKED is related to RAHDEK 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37a793b95af4258f49c456b610bb45b47dde3f015112b18030568d5bf2722df4.png] 

For, RACIAL is related to CARLAI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f81dd4187b9ce15f13969bbde1ae0296ed58f86950475b7be239f5bd53f8ae15.png] 

Similarly, for** NIMBLE**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25b165f11db537a9b7fe2802e6162d5b79d902fd2c2c31f6c78814b063656269.png] 

So, NIMBLE will be related to MINLEB.

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
